newsitem.title: USA: AMR unit reaches tentative pilot contract.
newsitem.headline: AMR unit reaches tentative pilot contract.

text.p: American Eagle, a unit of AMR Corp, said on Thursday that the carrier and the Air Line Pilots Association have reached a tentative contract for its 1,900 pilots.
The tentative deal propses a single contract offering a single seniority roster for American Eagle pilots at any of the four AMR Eagle carriers, American Eagle said.
Presently, each of the AMR Eagle carriers has its own contract and seniority roster, American Eagle said.
American Eagle said the proposed contract would give American Eagle pilots annual wage adjustments while establishing a framework for negotiating subsequent contracts.
Further details of the agreement are not being disclosed.
Bargaining committees for the airline and the pilots' union are continuing to complete the contract language, American Eagle said.
